title: Vintage Glass Jar with Bamboo Lid, 23.7 fl oz - Airtight Decorative Food Storage Canisters for Kitchen Counter, Ideal for Candy, Sugar, Coffee, Tea,Cute Jar(Sunflower*1)
description:
About this item
Premium Material and Safety:The CUSTDE glass jar is made from thick, food-grade glass that is lead-free and BPA-free. It offers reliable quality and stability for daily use, making it a safe and durable choice for storing a variety of dry foods and room-temperature items.
Airtight Bamboo Lid for Lasting Freshness Each jar features a natural bamboo lid with a silicone sealing ring that creates a secure, airtight seal. This helps keep contents fresh and dry by protecting against moisture, air, and dust—ideal for maintaining the quality of coffee beans, candy, spices, and snacks.
Elegant Vintage Design with Embossed Sunflower Pattern Combining timeless style with functionality, the jar showcases a delicate sunflower-embossed design that adds vintage charm to any setting. It serves as both a decorative piece and a practical storage solution for kitchens, dining rooms, bars, and offices.
Compact Size with Practical Capacity Measuring 5.5 x 3.82 inches (14 x 9.8 cm), the jar holds up to 23.7 fl oz (700 ml) of liquid or approximately 0.54 lbs (230 g) of coffee beans. The wide 2.95-inch (7.5 cm) opening ensures easy access and cleaning, while the total weight (with lid) is 460 g—perfect for everyday use without taking up too much space.
Versatile Storage for Home & Gifting These multi-size, patterned glass jars are ideal for organizing kitchen staples such as sugar, salt, tea, and herbs, or for presenting snacks like candies, coffee beans, and nuts in style. Their elegant appearance and practical design make them excellent gifts for holidays, housewarmings, or festive occasions.
